title: Subworkflow Trigger Node
description: Workflow entry point marking the workflow as eligible to be invoked as a sub-workflow (Reference mode)

input_schema.description: JSON Schema defining the structure and validation rules for inputs passed to the workflow when invoked as a sub-workflow

output_schema.description: JSON Schema defining the outputs exposed to parent workflows. Provides encapsulation—parent sees only declared fields, not internal child step structure.

output_mapping.description: Template expressions mapping internal step outputs to declared output fields. Keys are dotted paths from output_schema; values are template expressions (e.g., '${step.field}').

resultSchema.description: Trigger result is the invocation input data passed through directly

oneOf.title: Completed Result
oneOf.description: Pass-through of sub-workflow invocation input data

oneOf.title: Failed Result
oneOf.description: Trigger failure output for reporting purposes
